correctness.rationale: The projective-F2 rational point ideal is generated in degree three by six Frobenius binomials. Its 24 linear multiples have degree-four rank20, while multiples of G by four independent linear forms reduce the quartic-section quotient to 16 dimensions. A fresh independent bitset implementation enumerated all 65536 quotient masks and tested all 15 F2 points: exactly 288 have transverse gradients at every rational point. For those 288, independently computed exact Gröbner bases over F2 for all four affine charts of the complete-intersection Jacobian ideals give 144 geometrically smooth and 144 singular cases; five disjoint replay slices had smooth counts 28,28,28,28,32. An independent Cech cohomology computation forms the 19-dimensional kernel of multiplication by G on H^3(P3,O(-7)); multiplying Frobenius by GF gives rank19 on this kernel for every one of the 144 independently smooth masks (and images preserve the kernel). Thus all are ordinary. Degree=3*4=12, adjunction gives genus19, and smooth connected complete intersections are geometrically integral. Exhaustive finite algebra over F2 plus the Jacobian criterion proves the classification over the algebraic closure; finite-extension point sampling alone would not.
residual_risks: The exact census counts embedded divisor classes on one specified cubic and no automorphism identifications. Computations use exact characteristic-2 Groebner membership; independent source replay available. It does not classify other cubics or q>2.
